headline: Galaga
title: Galaga 1981 Facts | The Dual Fighter Trick | Namco Arcade | Classic Games
video_script: Galaga came out in nineteen eighty one from Namco, as the sequel to Galaxian. The Boss Galaga can grab your ship with a tractor beam. But if you rescue it, you get a dual fighter with double the firepower. The idea came from a movie the designer Shigeru Yokoyama had seen. Did you ever get the dual fighter? Comment below!
description: Galaga (1981, Namco), sequel to Galaxian. Boss Galaga can capture the player's ship with a tractor beam; rescuing it gives a dual fighter. Led by Shigeru Yokoyama.
